scope: Fresh source parse, expansion, complete checking, library emission and output write/hash. No native oracle, cached AST, body exclusion or output patch. Output import and actual parser/empty-checker smoke are measured separately. These timings are not a stage1/stage2 fixedpoint proof.
exportPolicy: Unmodified official js_lib(book,true) chooses its actual public export set. Source compiler receives that exact ordered list via its typed public emitter_step API. The nine corpus.exports are only the root ABI, not the fair all-public export set.
runtime: Node23.11.0 / V8 12.9.202.28-node.14 / darwin arm64; Bun1.4.2 supervises
reproduction: Use fresh report paths. Recreate only the 50 manifest members from sourceCommit, preserving relative paths; verify every SHA. Populate frozen bend2/bend.ts and bend2/comp.ts from officialCommit, verify the separate expected official hashes. Set manifest.directory to the recreated source-only directory. Required native40 component is reproducible by the executed sourcePreparationRecipe in compiler-timing-comparison237-v40.json. Generate official exports first, then use that fresh receipt for each candidate. No compiler images or AST transports are stored in Git.
rejectedSetup: The first official-a attempt used the Node main thread: increasing V8 stack alone did not supply the actual worker stack and emission terminated with SIGSEGV. No time from that run is accepted. Both recorded PASS runs use Worker resourceLimits.stackSizeMb=256.
interpretation: The JS-executed Bend checker is the dominant gap. Native C execution, scheduled typed identity tails, arena word-copy batching, and immutable source-pattern binder certificates are isolated unaccepted experiments. Native C execution would not by itself establish a self-generated C backend or a new JS byte fixedpoint. The current accepted fixedpoint remains v40.
